value: Open OrcaSlicer -> Calibration -> Flow Rate -> Pass 1
Feel each slide and determine the smoothest surface
Note the slide number (e.g. -10 for 90% slide)
Enter Pass 1 slide value and calculate Pass 1 Flow Rate
Run Pass 2 with the Pass 1 Flow Rate
Enter Pass 2 slide value to get final flow rate
Use Pass 2 Flow Rate in your slicer
This is the RECOMMENDED method for flow calibration
